questions.question: A man in a crowd begged Jesus to help his only son. What was wrong with the boy?

answers.text: A fever would not leave him
He had been blind from birth

questions.question: When a demon threw a boy to the ground as he came to Jesus, what did Jesus do?

answers.text: Rebuked the spirit and healed the boy
Told His disciples to try again
Sent the boy to see the priest

questions.question: When Jesus' disciples argued about which of them was the greatest, who did Jesus have stand beside Him?
Jesus told His arguing disciples that whoever is the least among them is the greatest. True or false?
